case.title: The Hotel Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Meridian Grand Hotel, the loss of a secret new machine has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 6 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The loss of a secret new machine
case.target_fake_identity: Victoria Sterling, a security adviser people trust
case.escape_plan: Victoria Sterling plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.description: A huge hall with stone floors and a wide staircase.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Soft yellow light, leather chairs, and slow music playing.

rooms.description: A long table, still set for dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Book shelves, a heavy desk, and one locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Cool night air, tall bushes, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Rooms
rooms.description: A hallway of numbered doors. Most are half open.

hidden_clues: Victoria Sterling's story about where they were does not match the a photo.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a security adviser
solution.reasoning: Victoria Sterling is the hidden person. The main clues (a photo, a scary note) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: One of the 6 guests at The Meridian Grand Hotel is using a fake name. Look for clues, compare their stories, and unmask the one behind the loss of a secret new machine. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.
